description: Smart wait until a selector or text appears, disappears, or meets state condition with timeout — or sleep for a fixed duration (waitMs/sleepMs/ms), or wait for document.readyState === 'complete' when called with no arguments.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

ms.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep

selector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep

text.description: Optional text to wait for on the page

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to sleep (either pure sleep when no selector/text is given, or extra settle sleep after selector/text condition passes)
